events.title: Mozilla Foundation created
events.summary: The Mozilla Foundation launched on July 15, 2003 to steward Firefox, Thunderbird, and open web standards after AOL scaled back Netscape.
events.about: Mozilla kept a nonprofit home for browser engine development independent of any single vendor — influencing WebKit, Chromium competition, and MDN documentation developers rely on.

narrative.whyChosen: Mozilla Foundation preserved an independent browser voice post-Netscape.
narrative.whyImportant: It sustained open web advocacy when commercial browsers consolidated.
narrative.problemSolved: Browser innovation risked collapsing into IE monopoly without nonprofit stewardship.
